purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century Wallich and Ronald Ross microscope-slide nodes recovered through deep object/archive cross-search.
guards: Do not assume that the current NHM Wallich collection is identical to the 1867 Royal Microscopical Society donation; test collection identity through specimen numbers labels drawings manuscripts and acquisition records.
Preserve conflicting source dates for Ross slides rather than normalising them away.
Treat later re-examination digitisation and museum custody as events attached to historical slides.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Protist Collection
adapters.target: official current protist collection page plus NHM Data Portal and archive catalogue
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate records explicitly attributed to the Wallich collection and compare specimen identifiers/provenance against the 1867 RMS 1031-slide gift and the 1912 J.C. Stevens purchase proposal before asserting continuity.

adapters.institution_scope: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine Ross Collection
adapters.target: official Ross archive catalogue and LSHTM pages documenting the surviving malaria slide box
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate box/slide records if exposed and connect them to Ross notebook/correspondence; preserve 1890s versus 1900 wording as source-specific dating until individual labels resolve it.
